root.label: Containers & invalidation
root.note: Physical memory layout directly predicts iterator, pointer, and reference invalidation.

children.label: Contiguous buffers (vector)
children.note: One heap array maximizes cache locality while reallocation moves every element.

children.label: Reallocation invalidates everything
children.note: Growing capacity invalidates all iterators, pointers, and references.

children.label: push_back within capacity
children.note: When capacity suffices, appending invalidates only the past-the-end iterator.

children.label: move_if_noexcept growth guard
children.note: Missing noexcept on move constructors forces vector reallocation to copy.

children.label: vector<bool> proxy reference
children.note: operator[] returns a bit-proxy rather than bool&, dangling if deduced via auto.

children.label: Chunked blocks (deque)
children.note: A spine of fixed pages lets ends grow without moving existing elements.

children.label: Ends keep pointers & refs
children.note: push_back and push_front preserve pointers and references to existing elements.

children.label: Ends invalidate all iterators
children.note: Spine reallocation invalidates every deque iterator on push_back or push_front.

children.label: Middle insert or erase
children.note: Modifying interior positions invalidates all iterators, pointers, and references.

children.label: Node-based trees & lists
children.note: Standalone heap nodes give complete stability across insertions and other erasures.

children.label: Insertions never invalidate
children.note: Adding nodes preserves all iterators, pointers, and element references.

children.label: Erasures isolate removed node
children.note: Erasing invalidates only iterators, pointers, and references to removed elements.

children.label: C++17 extract & merge
children.note: Transfers heap nodes between maps without copying or moving keys and values.

children.label: Unordered hash tables
children.note: Bucket array plus linked nodes separates iterator invalidation from node addresses.

children.label: Rehash invalidates iterators only
children.note: Growing bucket tables invalidates all iterators while keeping node pointers valid.

children.label: Erasure preserves siblings
children.note: Removing a bucket entry invalidates only handles to the erased element.

children.label: C++23 flat_map & erasure
children.note: Sorted parallel contiguous arrays trade node stability for cache speed.

children.label: Any mutation invalidates handles
children.note: Insertions and erasures shift contiguous slots, invalidating all pointers and iterators.

children.label: Uniform C++20 std::erase_if
children.note: Safely deletes matching elements across sequence and associative containers.
